parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
状态。取值范围：

- DISABLED
- ENABLED

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: 标签键值对。n的取值范围为 [1, 20]。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs create-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name xx --target-type DISK --state ENABLED --desc xxx --schedule CronExpression=0_0_0/24_0_0_0 --retain-rule Number=10 TimeInterval=14 TimeUnit=DAYS --storage-rule EnableImmediateAccess=false --cross-region-copy-info '{"Enabled":false,"Regions":[{"RetainDays":7,"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou"}]}' --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --resource-group-id xxx --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --special-retain-rules '{"Enabled":true,"Rules":[{"SpecialPeriodUnit":"WEEKS","TimeInterval":14,"TimeUnit":"WEEKS"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs CreateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'tag-key' --StorageRule '{"EnableImmediateAccess":false}' --ResourceGroupId xxx --SpecialRetainRules '{"Enabled":true,"Rules":[{"SpecialPeriodUnit":"WEEKS","TimeInterval":14,"TimeUnit":"WEEKS"}]}' --CrossRegionCopyInfo '{"Enabled":false,"Regions":[{"RetainDays":7,"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou"}]}' --RetainRule '{"Number":10,"TimeInterval":14,"TimeUnit":"DAYS"}' --Name xx --Desc xxx --State ENABLED --Schedule '{"CronExpression":"0_0_0/24_0_0_0"}' --Tag.1.Value 'tag-value' --TargetType DISK --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'
